# Seagull Electronics (concept by Kerblabs)

> Luxury home automation and audio visual company in Jupiter, FL. Facts from seagullelectronics.com. This is an unofficial concept page.

## Services
Video, audio, theater, outdoor, lighting, shades, networking, security, control systems.
